component.name: NautiBoy
component.summary: Control a Corsair Nautilus LCD from Linux

description.p: NautiBoy is an unofficial Linux controller for the hardware-tested Corsair Nautilus LCD Cap.

Choose among Thermals, Image, GIF, and Creative modes. Display local JPEG, PNG, and animated GIF media; monitor up to two Linux temperature sensors with the animated Orbit design; or combine media, Orbit, and telemetry in four persistent Creative presets.
NautiBoy can run in the system tray, start with the desktop session, optionally resume the last successfully sent display, and safely restore the controller's stored hardware-mode content.
GIPHY search is optional, experimental, and requires a user-provided API key. Local media does not require GIPHY.
Hardware validation is limited to CORSAIR Nautilus LCD Cap 1b1c:0c57, interface 0, firmware 0.3.0.5, on Fedora KDE Plasma 44.
NautiBoy is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Corsair.

description.p: First public beta with static and animated media, Thermals Orbit, four Creative presets, optional experimental GIPHY search, KDE tray integration, autostart, and opt-in display resume.
